question_or_proposition: For permit provisions that reference 4Q3, does the defined term—the lowest four-day average flow rate expected to occur once every three years—characterize receiving-water flow, effluent discharge flow, or some other identified flow at the permitted facility?
required_context: Permit or fact sheet provisions that apply 4Q3 to effluent limits, mixing-zone or dilution calculations, or monitoring conditions
The designated flow measurement location or stream reach associated with any 4Q3 value used in the permit
notes: The nominated span is a glossary definition only; it does not identify which flow body or location the 4Q3 statistic describes. If 4Q3 is used in flow-dependent limits, monitoring triggers, or conditional no-monitoring determinations, resolving which flow it designates would change applicability and compliance outcomes under purposes A, B, and C.
